dedupe_keys.name: awesome demographic and socio economic scenarios

description: The AWESOME project publishes demographic and economic driver projections for 21 Mediterranean and adjacent countries and an aggregate region over 2020 to 2100. A public text data description names SSP1 through SSP5, country and regional population projections, fertility, life expectancy and migration files, including probabilistic quantiles by age, sex and period. Zenodo lists R data archives, an economic-projections XLSX and a methods report under CC BY 4.0. These scenario drivers could set future demand assumptions for energy, water or food-system simulations. The values are model-generated SSP projections, not observed future population or guaranteed national forecasts. The README documents file types and country names, but the underlying RDA archives and spreadsheet were not downloaded, so quantile structure and units remain unchecked. An upstream Bayesian population method and MaGE economic model are described, not deposited here as executable tools. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these AWESOME scenario files.
